# stdx.otel

<!-- Generated by `badger doc std` from the checked interfaces (badger 0.1.0). Do not edit by hand. -->

OpenTelemetry export: logs (`std.log`), spans (`trace.span`), and metrics
(`std.metrics`) sent to an OTLP/HTTP collector as JSON (`/v1/logs`,
`/v1/traces`, `/v1/metrics`) by a background task, every `interval` and
once more when it stops. Records wait in bounded buffers between
exports (the oldest are dropped, and counted, when the collector falls
behind); a failed export is counted in the `otel.export_failures` metric
and never fails the program.

### `exporter`

```badger
exporter: system.Provider<{endpoint: String, service: String, interval: Duration}, otel.Exporter, io.Error>
```

Provider of an exporter for `{endpoint, service, interval}` (see
`from_env`); it stops, exporting what is left, when its system halts.

### `flush`

```badger
fn flush(e: Exporter) -> Unit
```

Export what is waiting now, from the calling task.

### `from_env`

```badger
fn from_env() -> Options !{Io}
```

Options from the standard environment: `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT`
(default `http://localhost:4318`), `OTEL_SERVICE_NAME` (default
`unknown_service`), and `OTEL_METRIC_EXPORT_INTERVAL` in milliseconds
(default 5000).

### `start`

```badger

```

Start exporting with `options`.

### `stop`

```badger

```
